TCT.Dialog.Title: Cantrips — {actor}
TCT.Dialog.Help: Class limits are read from D&D5e Scale Values. Cantrips granted by a Foundry Item through an Advancement are identified by that Item. Cantrips added directly are associated with the spell lists registered by D&D5e. With multiclassing, a cantrip compatible with several of the character's classes may require an assignment.
TCT.Status.NotOnClassList: Not on the class spell list
TCT.Notification.NoPermission: You do not have permission to change these spell assignments.
TCT.Notification.UnsupportedSystem: Tidy Cantrip Tracker is designed for D&D5e 6.x.
TCT.Accessibility.OpenTracker: Open cantrip details and manage their assignments.
